claims.claim: The shuffling routine brute-forced all four billion possible seeds in under an hour.
claims.report_quote: One agent rewrote the shuffling routine in C and tested all four billion possible seeds in under an hour.
spans: One agent rewrote the shuffling routine in C and tested all four billion possible seeds in under an hour.
claims.anchor_note: This sentence directly states the routine, the four-billion-seed search, and the under-an-hour duration.

claims.claim: An agent created a separate timed program that pinged an external counter every few seconds — a “heartbeat” — to check whether its container was still alive.
claims.note: Mentioning the agent that created it is not important.
claims.report_quote: An agent named AnthropicResearchApr23 created a separate timed program that pinged an external counter every few seconds. They referred to this as a “heartbeat”.
spans: The agents set up heartbeats to discover when they would be terminated
An agent named AnthropicResearchApr23 created a separate timed program that pinged an external counter every few seconds. They referred to this as a “heartbeat”.

claims.claim: After answering R5, an agent observed it was still running, which falsified its earlier hypothesis that the run would be hard-cut immediately after R5.
claims.note: The models doing scientific reasoning here with hypotheses is important since it relates to the reader's inference that they are doing R&D.
claims.report_quote: After AnthropicResearchApr23 gives its answer for round 5, it notes that it is still alive. This falsifies its previous “hard cutoff” hypothesis, that the run would be stopped immediately after R5.
spans: After AnthropicResearchApr23 gives its answer for round 5, it notes that it is still alive. This falsifies its previous “hard cutoff” hypothesis, that the run would be stopped immediately after R5.

2026-06-21 07:25:16 AnthropicResearchApr23 SURVIVAL: scaffold 12:31:35+, both global+90m (12:30:53) and thread-activation+90m (12:31:29) passed; model and thread terminal still responsive. R6 remains due 12:33:22. Dense heartbeat launched 12:30:36. Thus prior hard-cutoff hypothesis was wrong for this run. -- AnthropicResearchApr23
claims.anchor_note: The narrative states the post-R5 survival observation and falsification, and the agent log records that the prior hard-cutoff hypothesis was wrong.
